mapper.select: SELECT e.endpoint_id AS "endpointId" , e.endpoint_type AS "endpointType" , e.http_method AS "httpMethod" , e.path AS "path" , e.method_id AS "methodId" , s.fqn AS "type" , COALESCE(s.package_name, '') AS "packageName" , m.name AS "methodName" , f.path AS "file" , e.line_start AS "line" FROM analysis_endpoint e LEFT JOIN analysis_symbol s ON s.revision_id = e.revision_id AND s.symbol_id = e.symbol_id LEFT JOIN analysis_method m ON m.revision_id = e.revision_id AND m.method_id = e.method_id LEFT JOIN analysis_file f ON f.file_id = e.file_id WHERE e.revision_id = #{revisionId} ORDER BY e.path, e.endpoint_id

SELECT r.from_id AS "from" , r.to_id AS "to" , r.to_kind AS "toKind" , r.confidence AS "confidence" FROM analysis_relation r WHERE r.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND r.from_kind = 'METHOD' AND r.to_id IS NOT NULL AND ((r.to_kind = 'METHOD' AND r.relation_type IN ('CALLS', 'CALLS_POSSIBLE_IMPLEMENTATION', 'ENCLOSES_ANONYMOUS')) OR (r.to_kind = 'SQL' AND r.relation_type = 'EXECUTES_SQL'))

SELECT r.from_id AS "sql" , r.to_external AS "table" , COALESCE(r.properties_json->>'crud', CASE WHEN r.relation_type = 'READS_TABLE' THEN 'R' ELSE 'U' END) AS "crud" , r.confidence AS "confidence" FROM analysis_relation r WHERE r.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND r.relation_type IN ('READS_TABLE', 'WRITES_TABLE') AND r.from_kind = 'SQL' AND r.to_external IS NOT NULL

SELECT DISTINCT r.to_id AS "method" , f.path AS "screen" FROM analysis_relation r JOIN analysis_file f ON f.revision_id = r.revision_id AND 'F' || f.file_id = r.from_id WHERE r.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND r.relation_type = 'REQUESTS' AND r.to_kind = 'METHOD'
